name: telegram
description: Read your own Telegram account from a local agent: find a chat, read history, search, download attachments. Sending is off unless TELEGRAM_PLUGIN_ALLOW_SEND=1.

interface.shortDescription: Read your own Telegram account from a local agent.
interface.longDescription: Finds chats, reads history and threads, searches across chats and downloads attachments through a JSON command-line interface, so an agent can summarise or extract without a per-task script. Runs as your own Telegram user, needs a local Python runtime, and cannot send unless you deliberately enable it.
